[96m[1mPICO CLI · Spatial development toolkit[22m[39m
[1mBuild, run, and troubleshoot PICO Spatial apps with confidence[22m
[2mOne command line for project setup, app workflows, and environment diagnostics.[22m

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli[22m [command] [options]

[1mQuick start[22m:
  [1mpico-cli setup[22m           Required once for every new project
  [1mpico-cli doctor [--fix][22m  Run live checks; --fix repairs supported issues

[1mCore workflows[22m:
  [1mCreate[22m  project templates · editor 3D assets
  [1mRun[22m     emulator start → app install → app launch
  [1mDebug[22m   app logcat · capture screenshot · perf trace

[1mCommands[22m:
  [1msetup[22m      Required once per new project to initialize PICO tooling
  [1mdoctor[22m     Diagnose modules and project readiness; fix supported issues
  [1mproject[22m    Create PICO projects and inspect project context
  [1mworkflow[22m   Discover, start, resume, and inspect installed Workflow Packages
  [1meditor[22m     Manage Spatial Editor and package 3D assets
  [1memulator[22m   Manage the PICO Emulator lifecycle, setup, and diagnostics
  [1mdevice[22m     Connect to and inspect PICO devices
  [1mapp[22m        Install, launch, and inspect apps
  [1mfiles[22m      Push, pull, and manage device files
  [1mcapture[22m    Capture screenshots and recordings
  [1mlog[22m        Read logcat output from the current target
  [1mshell[22m      Run a one-off shell command on the current target
  [1mperf[22m       Record, query, and inspect performance traces
  [1mplugin[22m     Diagnose and update agent plugins
  [1mknowledge[22m  Install or update PICO development knowledge
  [1murl[22m        Launch URLs and PICO Web apps
  [1mspatialml[22m  SpatialML setup, pipeline, and model workflows
  [1mupdate[22m     Check for and install pico-cli updates
  [1mcleanup[22m    Remove recorded agent plugins and downloaded toolchain
  [1mtelemetry[22m  View and manage telemetry

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m-h, --help[22m     Show this message and exit.
  [1m-v, --version[22m  Print version information and exit.

[1mTelemetry[22m:
When telemetry is enabled:
We collect certain non‑personal information in aggregated form, primarily
  including product‑related access events, session duration, feature crash
  events and other similar metrics. This information is collected to enhance
  the services we deliver to you. We will use non‑personal information
  separately from personal information to the extent practicable. Should we
  combine the foregoing data with personal information for processing, we will
  obtain your consent in compliance with applicable personal information
  collection requirements.
Run `pico-cli telemetry status` for details, or opt out with
`pico-cli telemetry disable` (or PICO_CLI_NO_TELEMETRY=1).
